channel.title: Vatsal Trivedi
channel.description: Full Spectrum Engineer in Bengaluru. AI platforms, enterprise integrations, and developer tools that ship to production.

item.title: Who are you?
item.description: Someone asked me a question I thought I could answer in a sentence. I gave them my job title instead.
item.author: Vatsal Trivedi

item.title: Why `git pull` Says "Repository Not Found" (When the Repo Exists)
item.description: On a machine with more than one GitHub account, "Repository not found" usually means the wrong identity is cached—not a bad remote URL.
item.author: Vatsal Trivedi

item.title: AI as a Tool, Not a Substitute for Thought
item.description: AI can amplify judgment or replace it. The difference is intentionality—which skills we delegate, which we strengthen, and how we spend the time we save.
item.author: Vatsal Trivedi

item.title: My SonarQube Scans Were Crawling; Turns Out Docker on WSL 2 Only Had 1 CPU and 1 GB of RAM
item.description: A short, practical walkthrough of diagnosing slow SonarQube scans on Docker Desktop for Windows, fixing it with a .wslconfig file, and validating the change against Microsoft's official spec.
item.author: Vatsal Trivedi

item.title: I Got Tired of Manual Code Reviews So I Built a Free Automated Security Pipeline
item.description: Pre-commit hooks, GitHub Actions, and SonarQube—three free layers that catch secrets, CVEs, and Django footguns without a sales call.
item.author: Vatsal Trivedi

item.title: The "Lazy" Developer's Guide to Twilio Auto-Replies (No Server Required)
item.description: Send default SMS replies with Twilio TwiML Bins—no webhook server, no deploy. Welcome messages and acknowledgements straight from the Console.
item.author: Vatsal Trivedi

item.title: How to Fix the NVM for Windows `NVM_SYMLINK` Activation Error
item.description: NVM_SYMLINK fails when C:\\Program Files\\nodejs is a real folder, not a symlink. Here is a guaranteed step-by-step fix for the activation error.
item.author: Vatsal Trivedi

item.title: From MySQL to PostgreSQL: My Django Migration Story (and a Tool to Help)
item.description: How I moved a Django app from MySQL to PostgreSQL safely—and the open-source toolkit I built with dry-run, connection checks, and type mapping.
item.author: Vatsal Trivedi

item.title: Leaving Breadcrumbs for Your AI: The Hansel and Gretel Approach
item.description: Instead of giant terminal prompts, leave @implement and @docs comment directives in your code—breadcrumbs your AI can follow right where the work lives.
item.author: Vatsal Trivedi

item.title: The Cleanest Way to Handle Unused Variables in TypeScript
item.description: Don't disable the linter or ignore yellow squiggles. The humble underscore `_` signals intentional unused vars—and keeps `@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars` earning its keep.
item.author: Vatsal Trivedi

item.title: My Pinch of Salt: Did AI and LLMs Kill the "First-Time Correct" Engineer?
item.description: We used to plan before we typed. Now we prompt, push, and patch. Are we trading craftsmanship for the fleeting high of a green pipeline?
item.author: Vatsal Trivedi

item.title: Let's Be Real: It's Time to Ditch `any` for `unknown` in TypeScript
item.description: We've all reached for `any` as a quick fix, but it comes at a steep cost. Discover why `unknown` is the safer, smarter alternative that will save you from future headaches.
item.author: Vatsal Trivedi
